summary: Began implementing the journal_search tool and segment chunking for Gizmo's memory journal. Added a journal-chunk module and refactored JournalStore.append/JournalRecorder.record to return arrays of segments (one source session may now produce several ~40 KB chunks), created journal-search.ts (lexical search with ranked excerpts and byte caps) and journal-tools.ts (defineTool wrappers for journal_search and journal_read), wired both into memory-journal.ts with promptSnippet/promptGuidelines plus a before_agent_start fallback for the systemPromptOverride path, fixed backfill-cli to use INIT_CWD/cwd as default workspace, and patched existing recorder/store tests for the new array return shape. tsc passes; tests and real-journal verification still pending.
decisions: Split large segments at ~40 KB on turn boundaries (a user message starts a turn, never break a tool call from its result), with the last chunk's lastEntryId remaining the resume point so resumeAfter and idempotent re-backfill keep working.

Changed JournalStore.append and JournalRecorder.record to return arrays of JournalSegmentMeta (previously single meta | undefined), because one source session can now produce several chunks; updated callers and tests accordingly.
Implemented lexical line-based search rather than embeddings/SQLite — the ~9 MB corpus greps in milliseconds and the journal is the authoritative layer the knowledge layer will later cite.

Search returns ranked excerpts with surrounding context lines and a total byte cap so broad queries can't blow up the model's context, and journal_read is added as a companion to fetch a full segment by id after a hit.

Tool exposure uses promptSnippet + promptGuidelines (the guidelines name journal_search explicitly) and adds a before_agent_start handler that appends a tool-availability line to event.systemPrompt, because pi-session-factory's systemPromptOverride discards toolSnippets/promptGuidelines when active.

backfill-cli now defaults workspacePath to process.argv[2] ?? process.env.INIT_CWD ?? process.cwd(), so `pnpm --filter @gizmo/agent-server backfill` resolves to the repo root instead of the package directory.
Tests go under apps/agent-server/tests/memory/ and tests/pi-extensions/ (mirroring src/), since vitest.config.ts only includes tests/**/*.test.ts and colocated tests silently never run.
